card.name: Chickenpox, shingles and lupus term pieces
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after names of viral infections and autoimmune diseases, such as chickenpox, varicella, herpes zoster, measles and lupus. It also fires on linking words like 'and' or 'to' right after these names.

modes.label: Inside disease names
modes.description: Middle or end of a long disease name such as varicella, chickenpox or lupus erythematosus.
modes.example: If varic<<ella>> develops, treatment with antiviral agents

modes.label: Linking word after infection name
modes.description: A small word like 'and' or 'to' right after chickenpox, varicella or exposed, before the next infection such as measles.
